samplingOrder: signed axes, component scale and offset, enabled transforms in stored order, resource definition; 2D fields use transformed X/Z
driverComposition: probability * strength * mapped probability driver * mapped strength driver; disabled factors are 1
intervalPolicy: finite nonempty intervals; explicit inclusive endpoints; overlaps rejected; no match is NO_CHANGE
rotationPolicy: right-handed degrees; each listed axis rotates current coordinates about that fixed sampling-space axis; pivot applies before/after each transform
